title: orthochilus tabularis
intro: Orthochilus tabularis, commonly known as the Table Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Africa. It is a flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Orthochilus tabularis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and combat infections. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
